+@pytest.mark.parametrize("spec_version", ["2.4", "3.0"])
+async def test_streaming_response_stops_on_send_disconnect(spec_version: str) -> None:
+    streamed = 0
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        raise AssertionError("receive should not be called")
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        if message["type"] == "http.response.body":

+

+            yield b"chunk"
